subject: POC roadmap, weekly gates & owner alignment — CerebroHealth evaluation

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC roadmap, proposed success criteria & next steps (follow-up from demo)

Thanks for the time today — good session. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the kickoff: 

Summary of outcomes
- Scope: 6-week POC to validate retrieval + LLM ranking across Customer Support transcripts (sample size: ~200k docs).
- Success criteria (suggested):
  * Qualitative: system achieves >= 88% relevance on Cerebro holdout set (per your evaluation rubric).
  * Latency: median generation latency < 200ms for short-query path (p50) at 4 concurrent streams.
  * Throughput: sustained 20 requests/sec during peak batch tests.
  * Reliability: >= 99.5% availability for inference endpoints during test window.

High-level timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): contract + network enablement, share sample data access, sign NDA/SOW.
- Week 1 (kickoff): tech sync, baseline metrics, instrumenting telemetry.
- Weeks 2–3: ingestion & data validation, mapping evaluation prompts, run initial quality pass.
- Weeks 4–5: performance tuning, quantization/profile testing, cost/perf trade-offs.
- Week 6: final readout and decision meeting (success pass / next steps).

Weekly cadence
- 30–45m check-in, Thursdays 09:00 PT starting the week after kickoff (tech/ops on rotation).

Owners (Redwood) — draft
- Technical lead / runbook: Marissa Cole
- Infra & network (VPC peering / firewall): Ben Carter (+ Marcus Lin to execute peering)
- Success metric reporting: Marissa + Hannah

Immediate asks for your team
1) Confirm target kickoff week (we suggested May 3 — if that doesn't work, propose alternatives).
2) Share SOC2 snapshot + any compliance checklist items that must be onboarded before data access.
3) Provide a point of contact for network/VPN and a sample test IP range.

Attachments: POC_SOW_v0.2.pdf (draft SOW), redwood-network-reqs.xlsx (network checklist).

If that aligns, I'll circulate a final schedule and DocuSign link for the SOW.

Best,
Hannah
